comments.author: Montador
comments.body: I see people shouting to sell quests as well and I'm against the idea. You will hear this from me: "Giving again free .... quest. Come to guild if you want to fleet." I give them the quest and I'll even go do the quest with them fleeted. Why? Because I lose nothing by doing so. I'm going to do the quest anyway so it's no loss of my time. And, sometimes, I end up making a friend by doing this. What's more valuable - a friend or a couple million?
